svg.aria-label: JuanOS terminal running neofetch: Juan Mallo's avatar drawn in green ASCII art next to his specs. OS JuanOS 3D at juanos.pages.dev; role Data and AI Engineer; focus ML, multimodal and generative AI; research DREAM, LREC 2026, first author; location Madrid, Spain; status open to work. Then it types open juanos.pages.dev and boots JuanOS.
